name: Page Visit Counter Analytics
author: Ankit Panchal

sections.description:
Page Visit Counter Analytics is a lightweight, privacy-respecting WordPress analytics plugin that gives you full control over visitor insights without relying on third-party platforms. Unlike other analytics plugins, we focus on performance, ease of use, and giving you useful data without complexity.

🎯 Key Features

  • Real-time active visitors tracking
  • Session analytics with duration & bounce rate
  • Pageviews with 7-day trend chart
  • Top Pages & Posts with pagination
  • Device & Browser analytics
  • Built-in GeoIP integration
  • Modern, responsive dashboard
  • Privacy-first approach
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Visit Visit Counter > Dashboard to see analytics
  4. Configure tracking options under Visit Counter > Settings
sections.faq:
How does Page Visit Counter Analytics compare to Independent Analytics?

Page Visit Counter Analytics offers a more streamlined experience with real-time tracking, built-in GeoIP support, and a modern dashboard – all while maintaining privacy and performance. We focus on essential metrics without overwhelming you with complex features.

Is this plugin GDPR-compliant?

Yes. We take privacy seriously. The plugin:
– Doesn’t use cookies
– Doesn’t send data to third-party services
– Uses hashed IP addresses
– Collects only essential analytics data
– Is fully self-hosted

How does the tracking work?

The plugin uses a lightweight tracking system that:
– Tracks sessions and pageviews in real-time
– Uses session and IP hashes for anonymous tracking
– Doesn’t impact your site’s performance
– Works without external scripts or cookies

Can I customize what gets tracked?

Yes! You can:
– Exclude specific user roles
– Block specific IPs
– Track only logged-in users
– Select which post types to track
– Enable/disable specific metrics

Does it support custom post types?

Yes, you can choose which post types to track through the settings panel.

How does the GeoIP feature work?

The plugin uses MaxMind’s GeoLite2 database for country-level geolocation:
– Database is stored locally
– Updates automatically
– Only determines country of origin
– No personal data is sent to third parties
